question: Which disease in human beings is caused by UV radiation from the Sun?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Skin cancer.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The main types of skin cancer caused by **UV radiation** are basal cell carcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, and **melanoma.**
 
• **Melanomas:** Cancers that arise from melanocytes, the pigment-producing cells in the skin.
 
• Ultraviolet (UV) radiation was discovered in **1801** by German physicist **Johann Wilhelm Ritter.**
 
• UV rays were classified as part of the electromagnetic spectrum, situated between **visible light** and** X-rays**, with wavelengths ranging from **10 nm** to **400 nm**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pneumonia:**

 
 
• Pneumonia is a significant cause of **mortality worldwide**, especially among young children and the elderly.
 
• Vaccines such as the **pneumococcal vaccine** and **influenza vaccine **effectively reduce the incidence and severity of pneumonia.
 
 
 
• **Smallpox:**
 
 
• Smallpox was declared eradicated by the World Health Organization (WHO) in **1980.**
 
• the first disease to be eliminated through vaccination.
 
• The development of the smallpox vaccine by **Edward Jenner in 1796** laid the groundwork for modern immunology and vaccination practices.
 
 
 
• **Parkinson’s Disease:**
 
 
• Parkinson’s disease is a common** neurodegenerative disorder **that affects approximately 1% of the population over the age of 60.
 
• Symptoms include tremors, rigidity, and **bradykinesia** (slowness of movement), impacting daily life and motor functions.
